item.title: The JSFireTruck Situation
item.description:
Recently, cybersecurity researchers have discovered a “large-scale campaign” which is compromising legitimate websites via JavaScript injection.

These malicious injections are being obfuscated using a humourously named service JSFuck, which has since been renamed to JSFireTruck by security researchers owing to the profanity.
